content:
Alisa: Quick prototype uploaded — compact key list with denser rows + small permission badges. Trying to fit more keys on screen. Link: https://figma.com/file/abc123
Mike: I like the density, but worried about hit targets for keyboard users and touch. Can we keep row height >= 44px? :thinking_face:
Sasha: Agree with Mike. Also the revoke/danger CTA is now inline which visually competes with the copy. Feels risky for accidental clicks.
Dinesh: UX note: when you reduce row padding the affordance for drag handles and context menu gets cramped. We should test with 2x text size too.
Alisa: Good calls — I pushed a variant with a subtle divider and an expanded hit area for actions (invisible padding). Screenshot in the prototype.
Kevin: Can we also adjust the empty state? With denser rows the empty state looks very sparse. Maybe move CTA up and change copy to "Create your first credential" instead of generic "Create key".
Michelle: Microcopy: when a user hits revoke we currently say "Revoke key?" — propose: "Revoke API key: this will stop all traffic immediately. You can create a new key or undo within 30s." Add an undo affordance.
Sasha: Love the explicit consequences. Also accessibility: the danger modal needs clear aria-live region and focus trap. Right now focus moves to body.
Dinesh: +1 on undo, but be careful with safety. Undo window needs server support — is that implemented? @ui-bot can you confirm?
ui-bot: UI feature flag "revoke_undo" is currently off in staging. Backend endpoint /keys/{id}/undo exists but rate-limited.
Mike: If undo exists, copy should indicate timeframe (e.g., "undo available for 30s"). If not, use "irreversible" language and escalate to legal for compliance copy if necessary.
Alisa: For permissions badges — current small pill reads "Admin" or "Read". Suggest colored left border to improve scanability and add title attrs for screen readers.
Kevin: Also add keyboard-only visible focus styles on pills. Many of our users rely on keyboard nav to discover perms.
Michelle: Empty-state CTA placement: prefer center + prominent primary CTA, but secondary link to docs underneath. Example copy: "Create an API key to start calling Redwood Inference" + "Learn about scopes and least privilege".
Sasha: One visual nit: the compact table hides the created-at column — that's used in audits. Maybe collapse it into a hover/detail panel rather than remove.
Alisa: Plan: I'll iterate with 44px min row-height variant, keep created-at in details flyout, update revoke modal copy with undo language gated by feature flag, and update empty state copy. Will share new figma in ~2 hours.
Dinesh: Quick QA checklist: 1) Keyboard nav tab order, 2) Screen reader labels for actions, 3) Touchable targets >=44px, 4) Contrast for badges >=4.5:1.
Mike: Thanks — can someone add these to the PR checklist? Putting it here so design + eng align. :+1:
Alisa: Added to the PR checklist and the figma file. Thanks everyone!
